verdict.rationale: Codegen is built around an AI agent that users hand work to directly: it takes prompts to analyze requirements, implement features, fix bugs and write tests, and can be invoked from Slack, Linear, GitHub mentions, the CLI/TUI, and the SDK (`agent.run(prompt=...)`). It also presents structured plans and supports pausing and resuming runs. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that delegated tasks complete reliably, since all evidence is vendor documentation.
